# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Stronger hash seed generation**

## Highlights

Hash-code seeds now use operating-system cryptographic randomness in both SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. Hash codes remain randomized between processes and stable within a process. First use now initializes the cryptographic random-number generator.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Full-width random hash seeds** — The shared HashCode implementation replaces System.Random with RandomNumberGenerator, avoiding clock-seeded randomness on .NET Framework. This adds cryptography initialization to the first hash-code operation without changing within-process stability. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))
